interpretation_rules: Position weight is a common multiplicative factor within TE and cannot explain TE1-versus-TE24 spacing.
TE uses integer-age anchors in the deployed calculator; RB-only fractional-age and elite-youth mechanics must not be imported into TE analysis.
A structural audit may identify compression, discontinuities, lineage drift, or counterfactual sensitivity but cannot choose a new TE scale or age curve.
Weeks 1-3 realized outcomes are descriptive only and cannot authorize a model change.
Production V2 Phase 1 is an uncalibrated transparent benchmark, not a validated replacement.
No named TE may be manually raised or lowered from this audit.
Any follow-up model change requires a separately preregistered broad-cohort calibration/validation study.
primary_questions: Does the live TE board reproduce the exact deployed formula with no hidden TE-only mutation?
How much of within-TE spacing comes from production multiplier versus age multiplier?
Do TE age anchors create sharp pre-peak, peak-end, post-peak, or floor discontinuities?
Do elite floors, no-history role rescue, production clamps, or the age floor create structural cliffs?
Does the transparent Production V2 benchmark materially reorder TEs or mostly preserve current ordering?
Does legacy production-multiplier lineage show unusual TE drift relative to the overall player pool?
What do frozen Weeks 1-3 outcome diagnostics say about TE ordering while remaining descriptive only?
Does current TE position weight show cross-position tension in frozen pairwise diagnostics?
scope: All current PLAYER_DB tight ends in the deployed calculator.
